description: A 0.75 mm tube wall: printable (at least 0.7) but under the recommended 0.8 mm: warning. The finding reads only the measured minTubeWallMm, and its hint also reads tubeOuterDiameterMm when it is present (see fail-warning-grown), so the tube diameters are left out rather than contradict the wall.

findings.fix: raise the tubeOuterDiameter offset in fit profile `example-mk4s-petg-0.4` by 0.1 mm, or record a tube cell with a smaller bore, so the wall reaches 0.8 mm
findings.message: the thinnest tube wall is 0.75 mm after fit offsets: printable, but below the recommended 0.8 mm of process `fdm-0.4`
